purpose: Teach: 外注/両社/差し支え/損ね/歯科医/部内/組立/伝票

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業務、外注を増やすか、検討中だ。
lines.en: We're looking at increasing outsourced operations. Still reviewing the options.
lines.style: Measured, authoritative opening. Even pace. No hesitation—this is settled thinking, not tentative. Direct eye contact level. Matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。両社の協定、明日、調印します。
lines.en: Yes. We'll have both agreements signed tomorrow.
lines.style: Steady, attentive. Slight nod implied in the tone. Professional without stiffness. Confirming he understands the timeline and has it covered.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業務に差し支えがあるか、確認しろ。
lines.en: Verify whether this will create any operational friction.
lines.style: Direct instruction. Slight weight on 'verify.' Not harsh—delegating with precision. Assumes competence. Low, conversational volume.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。気を損ねないよう、丁寧に対応します。
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure we handle it carefully—keep people at ease.
lines.style: Respectful, deliberate. Light pause before the second clause, showing he's thought through the human side. Quiet assurance. Not defensive.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員の歯科医、紹介制度、続けよう。
lines.en: Let's keep the dental referral program running.
lines.style: Calm decision-maker. Warm undertone—this is the kind of benefit that matters. Not an afterthought, genuinely valued. Straightforward delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。部内会議、明日、設定済みです。
lines.en: Yes. I've already scheduled the section meeting for tomorrow.
lines.style: Efficient, slightly ahead of the curve. Small note of quiet competence—he's already done it. Alert, not rushed. Professional relief.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 組立工程、効率化、目標だ。
lines.en: Assembly efficiency is the target now.
lines.style: Clear, measured declaration. Slight emphasis on 'target'—this is where focus needs to go. Calm but serious. No dramatics.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経理、伝票、再確認しています。
lines.en: Yes. Finance is doing a full voucher review as we speak.
lines.style: Steady, reassuring. Implies he's already coordinated this. Attentive—showing the boss the groundwork is laid. Closing tone, wrapping up.
